spec.title: Alarms
spec.description: Per time bucket: true when the signal was true at any moment in that bucket.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
  max(muster__value) AS "Fire detection",
  max(fire_door_power_supply_failure__value) AS "Fire door power supply failure",
  max(auxiliary_system_emergency_supply_failure__value) AS "Aux. system emergency supply failure"
FROM public.marpower__fire_detection__general
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) 
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

spec.title: Alarms
spec.description: The latest value within the live window ($live_window), independent of the selected time range; empty when nothing was published in that window. Updated: seconds since the latest message.

spec.rawSql:
WITH l AS (
  SELECT * FROM public.marpower__fire_detection__general
  WHERE timestamp > now() - INTERVAL '$live_window' 
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1
)
SELECT s.signal AS "Signal",
  CASE s.n
    WHEN 1 THEN CASE l.muster__value WHEN true THEN 'Active' WHEN false THEN 'No' END
    WHEN 2 THEN CASE l.fire_door_power_supply_failure__value WHEN true THEN 'Active' WHEN false THEN 'No' END
    WHEN 3 THEN CASE l.auxiliary_system_emergency_supply_failure__value WHEN true THEN 'Active' WHEN false THEN 'No' END
  END AS "State",
  to_unixtime(now()) - to_unixtime(l.timestamp) AS "Updated"
FROM (VALUES
  (1, 'Fire detection', arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8'), arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8')),
  (2, 'Fire door power supply failure', arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8'), arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8')),
  (3, 'Aux. system emergency supply failure', arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8'), arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8'))
) AS s(n, signal, path, tag)
LEFT JOIN l ON true
ORDER BY s.n

spec.title: Fire panel
spec.description: Per time bucket: true when the signal was true at any moment in that bucket.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
  max(alarms__value) AS "Common alarm",
  max(faults__value) AS "Faults",
  max(disablements__value) AS "Disablements",
  max(tests__value) AS "Tests",
  max(testbit__value) AS "Test bit"
FROM public.marpower__fire_detection__main_panel
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) 
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

spec.title: Fire panel
spec.description: The latest value within the live window ($live_window), independent of the selected time range; empty when nothing was published in that window. Updated: seconds since the latest message. Analog values are rounded to 2 decimals; units are in the signal name.

spec.rawSql:
WITH l AS (
  SELECT * FROM public.marpower__fire_detection__main_panel
  WHERE timestamp > now() - INTERVAL '$live_window' 
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1
)
SELECT s.signal AS "Signal",
  CASE s.n
    WHEN 1 THEN CASE l.alarms__value WHEN true THEN 'Active' WHEN false THEN 'No' END
    WHEN 2 THEN CASE l.faults__value WHEN true THEN 'Active' WHEN false THEN 'No' END
    WHEN 3 THEN CASE l.disablements__value WHEN true THEN 'Active' WHEN false THEN 'No' END
    WHEN 4 THEN CASE l.tests__value WHEN true THEN 'Yes' WHEN false THEN 'No' END
    WHEN 5 THEN CASE l.testbit__value WHEN true THEN 'Yes' WHEN false THEN 'No' END
    WHEN 6 THEN arrow_cast(round(l.command__value, 2), 'Utf8')
    WHEN 7 THEN arrow_cast(round(l.parameter_1__value, 2), 'Utf8')
  END AS "State",
  to_unixtime(now()) - to_unixtime(l.timestamp) AS "Updated"
FROM (VALUES
  (1, 'Common alarm', arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8'), arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8')),
  (2, 'Faults', arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8'), arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8')),
  (3, 'Disablements', arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8'), arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8')),
  (4, 'Tests', arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8'), arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8')),
  (5, 'Test bit', arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8'), arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8')),
  (6, 'Command', arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8'), arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8')),
  (7, 'Parameter 1', arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8'), arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8'))
) AS s(n, signal, path, tag)
LEFT JOIN l ON true
ORDER BY s.n

SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
  avg(command__value) AS "Command",
  avg(parameter_1__value) AS "Parameter 1"
FROM public.marpower__fire_detection__main_panel
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) 
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

spec.title: Cabins
spec.description: Per device and time bucket, the worst flag seen: alarm, pre-alarm, fault, disabled, test.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT date_bin('$__interval', fire.timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
  meta.description,
  max(CASE
      WHEN fire.alarm__value THEN 5
      WHEN fire.pre_alarm__value THEN 4
      WHEN fire.fault__value THEN 3
      WHEN fire.disabled__value THEN 2
      WHEN fire.test__value THEN 1
      ELSE 0 END) AS state
FROM (SELECT timestamp, topic, technical_name, alarm__value, disabled__value, fault__value, pre_alarm__value, test__value FROM public.marpower__fire_detection__call_point UNION ALL SELECT timestamp, topic, technical_name, alarm__value, disabled__value, fault__value, pre_alarm__value, test__value FROM public.marpower__fire_detection__detector UNION ALL SELECT timestamp, topic, technical_name, alarm__value, disabled__value, fault__value, pre_alarm__value, test__value FROM public.marpower__fire_detection__sounder) AS fire
JOIN public.marpower__firedetection_metadata AS meta ON fire.topic = meta.topic
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND meta.section = 'Accommodation' AND meta.room_or_area LIKE '%Cabin%'
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

spec.title: Cabins
spec.description: The latest value within the live window ($live_window), independent of the selected time range; empty when nothing was published in that window. Updated: seconds since the latest message. Every device in the fire detection metadata is listed; its flags are empty when it published nothing in the live window.

spec.rawSql:
WITH f AS (
  SELECT topic,
    last_value(disabled__value ORDER BY timestamp) AS disabled,
    last_value(fault__value ORDER BY timestamp) AS fault,
    last_value(pre_alarm__value ORDER BY timestamp) AS prealarm,
    last_value(alarm__value ORDER BY timestamp) AS alarm,
    last_value(test__value ORDER BY timestamp) AS test,
    max(timestamp) AS ts
  FROM (SELECT timestamp, topic, technical_name, alarm__value, disabled__value, fault__value, pre_alarm__value, test__value FROM public.marpower__fire_detection__call_point UNION ALL SELECT timestamp, topic, technical_name, alarm__value, disabled__value, fault__value, pre_alarm__value, test__value FROM public.marpower__fire_detection__detector UNION ALL SELECT timestamp, topic, technical_name, alarm__value, disabled__value, fault__value, pre_alarm__value, test__value FROM public.marpower__fire_detection__sounder) AS src
  WHERE timestamp > now() - INTERVAL '$live_window'
  GROUP BY topic
)
SELECT meta.description,
  f.disabled AS disabled,
  f.fault AS fault,
  f.prealarm AS prealarm,
  f.alarm AS alarm,
  f.test AS test,
  to_unixtime(now()) - to_unixtime(f.ts) AS "Updated"
FROM public.marpower__firedetection_metadata AS meta
LEFT JOIN f ON f.topic = meta.topic
WHERE meta.section = 'Accommodation' AND meta.room_or_area LIKE '%Cabin%'
ORDER BY meta.description
